evidence: AutoConfig.from_pretrained() on a Qwen3-VL checkpoint-style config loads Qwen3VLConfig with top-level num_labels=20 and problem_type=multi_label_classification.
The nested Qwen3-VL text config still reports num_labels=2 and problem_type=None, so the serving path derives a 2-class head where the checkpoint expects 20 labels.
The captured repro output shows the mismatch explicitly: checkpoint score.weight shape (20, 4096) versus vLLM-side head shape (2, 4096).
steps: Created a checkpoint-style config.json matching the issue report.
Loaded it with transformers.AutoConfig in an isolated env.
Verified that the top-level Qwen3-VL config keeps num_labels=20 while the nested text config stays at 2.
Captured the reproduction output in repro_stdout.log and repro_stderr.log.
